description.narrative: The Resilient Futures Fund ’s approach is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses with affordable capital and technical assistance. By providing affordable loans and accompanying support, The Resilient Futures Fund will help climate‑focused SMEs scale up, creating jobs, boosting and stabilising the wider economy, contributing to state infrastructure and delivering climate focused goods and services. The Resilient Futures Fund will expand to meet its full vision over 3 phases of an income‑determined, multi‑year timetable, aiming to mobilise up to £20 million by 2033 in blended philanthropic and concessionary finance. However, Phase 1 establishes the fund’s model and raises initial philanthropic donations. In Phase 1, every pound donated is lent out to impact enterprises through our fund management partners, once repaid they re‑lent again, compounding its effect. For example, a £1,000 loan repaid over 12 months can be re‑deployed multiple times, amplifying the total economic value created. Internal projections suggest an SROI (social return on investment) in the range of 1:3 to 1:45 as the project is scaled, meaning each £1 donated could yield £3–£45 in social and economic value through leveraged growth whilst maintaining the original donation which will be loaned again. For every £1 donated in our foundation year will be matched by Christian Aid’s financial commitment; coupled with our targeted annual return of circa 7% every pound at the end of year 1 will be worth £2.14 with a social return on investment value of over £24. Every £1000 can deliver over £24,000 of impact for people and the planet. Phase 1 proceeds as follows: Christian Aid founds The Resilient Futures Fund and commits £250,000 which will be matched by £250,000 in philanthropic donations. The total £500,000 capacity for Phase 1 will be managed through our experienced fund management partners, Blue Orchard and Talanton. BlueOrchard, through their Impact Credit Fund will manage large‑scale loan disbursements, especially to local Micro Finance Institutions as well as direct to enterprises ensuring funding reaches the organisations that need it most whilst ensuring high social and environmental returns and safeguarding funds. Talanton Impact Fund will make selective direct investments in growing businesses. This blended approach spreads risk and expertise and ensures the high social and environmental impact we are targeting. In phase 1, Donations are directed straight to the initial investments whilst administrative costs are covered by additional funding meaning that every pound donated to The Resilient Futures Fund goes towards impact. Future loan repayments replenish the fund, so The Resilient Futures Fund becomes a semi‑revolving pool of capital.
